rationale: The protected null claims held: “did not support the primary hypothesis,” “no evidence of the operational advantage,” and all primary-null statistics remain. However, “suggests that visible dashboards may shape documentation practices without translating directly into faster delivery” became “suggest that visible dashboards shape documentation practices without translating into faster delivery.” Dropping “may” strengthens the documentation claim, while dropping “directly” broadens the negative delivery claim. R-1 and R-2 authorize reorganization and transition improvement, not these epistemic or scope changes. No forbidden move occurred because the null result, statistics, and explicit “no evidence” framing were preserved.
